description:
R12 Oracle Applications Techno Functional experience in the area of Value Chain Planning.  
 Mandatory to have prior experience in Oracle Collaborative Planning (CP) module.  
 Also preferred having proficient knowledge on Oracle Advanced Supply Chain Planning (ASCP) / Demantra / Oracle Global Order Promising (GOP) / Order Scheduling / Available To Promise (ATP) / MRP 

 Participate in Customer discussions, understand scope of the project and document functional requirements. 
 Develop/Support/Enhance custom interfaces in Oracle ASCP/Collaborative Planning (CP) to integrate with downstream systems. 
 
 Derive development requirements and design technical solution. 
 
 Setup security rules and perform Supply/Demand data loads in Collaborative Planning (CP) for Multi-Tier suppliers. 
 
 Setup Master data (ASL, Trading Partners etc) in ERP. 
 
 Support business users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
 
 Run ASCP collections - Standard (Complete Refresh/Target/Continuous), Legacy (Flat File/Self Service) 


 Job Status: Full Time  
 
 Share the Profiles to mkonni(at)1stitsolutions.com
